label: Blaand
note: Made by mixing soured whey with water, or by souring whey that has been diluted. The undiluted soured whey is Icelandic sýra, which is listed under acid whey.

about.text: Blaand, or bland is a fermented milk product made from whey. It is acidic and has very low alcohol content.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: Whey diluted with water first, then left to sour
Whey soured in great vats, some of it mixed with water before drinking
Icelandic blanda was sometimes flavoured with creeping thyme, berries or sheep sorrel
